meta.description: ABB ACH580 fault, warning and pure event codes (official names, short cause summary).
meta.source: ACH580 firmware manual, Fault tracing chapter (Warning messages + Fault messages tables)

0x1080.name: Backup/Restore timeout
0x1080.description: Control panel or PC tool has failed to communicate with the drive when backup was being made or restored.

0x1081.name: Rating ID fault
0x1081.description: Drive software has not been able to read the rating ID of the drive.

0x2281.name: Calibration
0x2281.description: Measured offset of output phase current measurement or difference between output phase U2 and W2 current measurement is too great (the values are updated during current calibration).

0x2310.name: Overcurrent
0x2310.description: Output current has exceeded internal fault limit. In addition to an actual overcurrent situation, this fault may also be caused by an earth fault or supply phase loss.

0x2330.name: Earth leakage
0x2330.description: Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable.

0x2340.name: Short circuit
0x2340.description: Short-circuit in motor cable(s) or motor.

0x2381.name: IGBT overload
0x2381.description: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature. This fault protects the IGBT(s) and can be activated by a short circuit in the motor cable.

0x3130.name: Input phase loss
0x3130.description: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is oscillating due to missing input power line phase or blown fuse.

0x3181.name: Wiring or earth fault
0x3181.description: Incorrect input power and motor cable connection (ie. input power cable is connected to drive motor connection).

0x3220.name: DC link undervoltage
0x3220.description: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is not sufficient because of a missing supply phase, blown fuse or fault in the rectifier bridge.

0x3381.name: Output phase loss
0x3381.description: Motor circuit fault due to missing motor connection (all three phases are not connected).

0x3385.name: Autophasing
0x3385.description: Autophasing routine (see section Autophasing on page 196) has failed.

0x4110.name: Control board temperature
0x4110.description: Control board temperature is too high.

0x4210.name: IGBT overtemperature
0x4210.description: Estimated drive IGBT temperature is excessive.

0x4310.name: Excess temperature
0x4310.description: Power unit module temperature is excessive.

0x4380.name: Excess temperature difference
0x4380.description: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.

0x4981.name: External temperature 1
0x4981.description: Measured temperature 1 has exceeded fault limit.

0x4982.name: External temperature 2
0x4982.description: Measured temperature 2 has exceeded fault limit.

0x4990.name: CPTC-02 not found
0x4990.description: CPTC-02 extension module is not detected in option slot 2.

0x5081.name: Auxiliary fan broken
0x5081.description: An auxiliary cooling fan (connected to the fan connectors on the control unit) is stuck or disconnected.

0x5089.name: SMT circuit malfunction
0x5089.description: Fault 4991 Safe motor temperature is generated but drive STO is not activated. Note: If only one STO channel is opened, fault FA81 Safe torque off 1 or FA82 Safe torque off 2 is generated.

0x5090.name: STO hardware failure
0x5090.description: STO hardware diagnostics has detected hardware failure.

0x5091.name: Safe torque off
0x5091.description: Safe torque off function is active, ie, safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector STO is broken during start or run.

0x5093.name: Rating ID mismatch
0x5093.description: The hardware of the drive does not match the information stored in the memory. This may occur, for example, after a firmware update.

0x5094.name: Measurement circuit temperature
0x5094.description: Problem with internal temperature measurement of the drive.

0x5681.name: PU communication
0x5681.description: Communication errors detected between the drive control unit and the power unit.

0x5682.name: Power unit lost
0x5682.description: Connection between the drive control unit and the power unit is lost.

0x5698.name: Unknown PU fault
0x5698.description: The power unit logic has generated a fault which is not known by the software.

0x6181.name: FPGA version incompatible
0x6181.description: Firmware and FPGA versions are incompatible.

0x6200.name: Checksum mismatch
0x6200.description: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.

0x6306.name: FBA A mapping file
0x6306.description: Fieldbus adapter A mapping file read error.

0x64b2.name: User set fault
0x64b2.description: Loading of user parameter set failed because • • •

0x64b3.name: Macro parameterization error
0x64b3.description: Loading of macro parameter set failed.

0x64ff.name: Fault reset
0x64ff.description: A fault has been reset from the control panel, Drive composer PC tool, fieldbus or I/O.

0x6591.name: Backup/Restore timeout
0x6591.description: During backup creating or restoring operation a control panel or PC tool has failed to communicate with the drive as part this operation.

0x65a1.name: FBA A parameter conflict
0x65a1.description: The drive does not have a functionality requested by PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.

0x6681.name: EFB comm loss
0x6681.description: Communication break in embedded fieldbus (EFB) communication.

0x6682.name: EFB config file
0x6682.description: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) configuration file could not be read.

0x6683.name: EFB invalid parameterization
0x6683.description: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) parameter settings inconsistent or not compatible with selected protocol.

0x6684.name: EFB load fault
0x6684.description: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) protocol firmware could not be loaded. Version mismatch between EFB protocol firmware and drive firmware.

0x6685.name: EFB fault 2
0x6685.description: Fault reserved for the EFB protocol application.

0x6686.name: EFB fault 3
0x6686.description: Fault reserved for the EFB protocol application.

0x6e21.name: Macro parameterization error
0x6e21.description: A macro file has a parameter defined in such a way that it cannot be written.

0x7081.name: Control panel loss
0x7081.description: Control panel or PC tool selected as active control location for drive has ceased communicating.

0x7086.name: AI Overvoltage
0x7086.description: An overvoltage has been detected on an analog input. The analog input has temporarily been changed to voltage mode and will be changed back to current mode when the AI signal level is back within...

0x7100.name: Excitation current
0x7100.description: Excitation current feedback low or missing

0x7121.name: Motor stall
0x7121.description: Motor is operating in stall region because of, for example, excessive load or insufficient motor power.

0x7181.name: Brake resistor
0x7181.description: Brake resistor broken or not connected.

0x7183.name: BR excess temperature
0x7183.description: Brake resistor temperature has exceeded fault limit defined by parameter 43.11 Brake resistor fault limit.

0x7184.name: Brake resistor wiring
0x7184.description: Brake resistor short circuit or brake chopper control fault.

0x7191.name: BC short circuit
0x7191.description: Short circuit in brake chopper IGBT.

0x7192.name: BC IGBT excess temperature
0x7192.description: Brake chopper IGBT temperature has exceeded internal fault limit.

0x7310.name: Overspeed
0x7310.description: Motor is turning faster than highest allowed speed due to incorrectly set minimum/maximum speed, insufficient braking torque or changes in load when using torque reference.

0x73b0.name: Emergency ramp failed
0x73b0.description: Emergency stop did not finish within expected time.

0x7510.name: FBA A communication
0x7510.description: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module A or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module A is lost.

0x7580.name: INU-LSU comm loss
0x7580.description: DDCS communication between the inverter unit and the supply unit is lost.

0x7583.name: Line side unit faulted
0x7583.description: The supply unit connected to the inverter unit has generated a fault.

0x7584.name: LSU charge failed
0x7584.description: The supply unit was not ready (ie. the main contactor/breaker could not be closed) within expected time.

0x8001.name: ULC underload fault
0x8001.description: User load curve: Signal has been too long under the underload curve.

0x8002.name: ULC overload fault
0x8002.description: User load curve: Signal has been too long over the overload curve.

0x80a0.name: AI supervision
0x80a0.description: An analog signal is outside the limits specified for the analog input.

0x80b0.name: Signal supervision 1
0x80b0.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 1.

0x80b1.name: Signal supervision 2
0x80b1.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 2.

0x80b2.name: Signal supervision 3
0x80b2.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 3.

0x80b3.name: Signal supervision 4
0x80b3.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 4.

0x80b4.name: Signal supervision 5
0x80b4.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 5.

0x80b5.name: Signal supervision 6
0x80b5.description: Fault generated by the signal supervision function 6.

0xa2b1.name: Overcurrent
0xa2b1.description: Output current has exceeded internal fault limit. In addition to an actual overcurrent situation, this warning may also be caused by an earth fault or supply phase loss.

0xa2b3.name: Earth leakage
0xa2b3.description: Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable.

0xa2b4.name: Short circuit
0xa2b4.description: Short-circuit in motor cable(s) or motor.

0xa2ba.name: IGBT overload
0xa2ba.description: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature. This warning protects the IGBT(s) and can be activated by a short circuit in the motor cable.

0xa3a1.name: DC link overvoltage
0xa3a1.description: Intermediate circuit DC voltage too high (when the drive is stopped).

0xa3a2.name: DC link undervoltage
0xa3a2.description: Intermediate circuit DC voltage too low (when the drive is stopped).

0xa3aa.name: DC not charged
0xa3aa.description: The voltage of the intermediate DC circuit has not yet risen to operating level.

0xa490.name: Incorrect temperature sensor setup
0xa490.description: Temperature cannot be supervised due to incorrect adapter setup.

0xa491.name: External temperature 1
0xa491.description: Measured temperature 1 has exceeded warning limit.

0xa492.name: External temperature 2
0xa492.description: Measured temperature 2 has exceeded warning limit.

0xa4a0.name: Control board temperature
0xa4a0.description: Control board temperature is too high. Temperature above warning limit

0xa4a1.name: IGBT overtemperature
0xa4a1.description: Estimated drive IGBT temperature is excessive.

0xa4b0.name: Excess temperature
0xa4b0.description: Power unit module temperature is excessive.

0xa4b1.name: Excess temperature difference
0xa4b1.description: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.

0xa582.name: Auxiliary fan missing
0xa582.description: An auxiliary cooling fan (IP55 internal fan) is stuck or disconnected.

0xa5a0.name: Safe torque off
0xa5a0.description: Safe torque off function is active, ie, safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector STO is lost.

0xa5ea.name: Measurement circuit temperature
0xa5ea.description: Problem with internal temperature measurement of the drive. Frames R1…R5

0xa5ef.name: PU state feedback
0xa5ef.description: State feedback from output phases does not match control signals.

0xa682.name: Flash erase speed exceeded
0xa682.description: The flash memory (in the memory unit) has been erased too frequently, compromising the lifetime of the memory.

0xa686.name: Checksum mismatch
0xa686.description: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.

0xa687.name: Checksum configuration
0xa687.description: An action has been defined for a parameter checksum mismatch but the feature has not been configured.

0xa6a4.name: Motor nominal value
0xa6a4.description: The motor parameters are set incorrectly. The drive is not dimensioned correctly.

0xa6a5.name: No motor data
0xa6a5.description: Parameters in group 99 have not been set.

0xa6a6.name: Voltage category unselected
0xa6a6.description: The voltage category has not been defined.

0xa6a7.name: System time not set
0xa6a7.description: System time is not set. Timed functions cannot be used and fault log dates are not correct.

0xa6b0.name: User lock is open
0xa6b0.description: The user lock is open, ie, user lock configuration parameters 96.100…96.102 are visible.

0xa6b1.name: User pass code not confirmed
0xa6b1.description: A new user pass code has been entered in parameter 96.100 but not confirmed in 96.101.

0xa6d1.name: FBA A parameter conflict
0xa6d1.description: The drive does not have a functionality requested by a PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.

0xa6e5.name: AI parametrization
0xa6e5.description: The current/voltage hardware setting of an analog input does not correspond to parameter settings.

0xa6e8.name: IPC version mismatch
0xa6e8.description: The master and follower(s) do not have the same IPC version and will not run in IPC mode.

0xa780.name: Motor stall
0xa780.description: Motor is operating in stall region because of, for example, excessive load or insufficient motor power.

0xa784.name: Motor disconnect
0xa784.description: All three output phases are disconnected from motor.

0xa792.name: Brake resistor wiring
0xa792.description: Brake resistor short circuit or brake chopper control fault. For drive frames R6 or larger.

0xa793.name: BR excess temperature
0xa793.description: Brake resistor temperature has exceeded warning limit defined by parameter 43.12 Brake resistor warning limit.

0xa794.name: BR data
0xa794.description: Brake resistor data has not been given.

0xa79c.name: BC IGBT excess temperature
0xa79c.description: Brake chopper IGBT temperature has exceeded internal warning limit.

0xa7ab.name: Extension I/O configuration failure
0xa7ab.description: Installed extension module is not the same as configured.

0xa7ac.name: I/O module internal error
0xa7ac.description: Calibration data is not stored in the IO module. Analog signals are not working with full accuracy.

0xa7c1.name: FBA A communication
0xa7c1.description: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module A or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module A is lost.

0xa7ce.name: EFB comm loss
0xa7ce.description: Communication break in embedded fieldbus (EFB) communication.

0xa7ee.name: Panel loss
0xa7ee.description: Control panel or PC tool selected as active control location for drive has ceased communicating.

0xa891.name: Limit word 1
0xa891.description: Drive operation limit is active in Parameter 30.01 Limit word 1.

0xa892.name: Torque limit word
0xa892.description: Torque controller limitation status is active in Parameter Parameter 30.02 Torque limit status.

0xa8a0.name: AI supervision
0xa8a0.description: An analog signal is outside the limits specified for the analog input.

0xa8a1.name: RO life warning
0xa8a1.description: The relay has changed states more than the recommended number of times.

0xa8a2.name: RO toggle warning
0xa8a2.description: The relay output is changing states faster than recommended, for example, if a fast changing frequency signal is connected to it. The relay lifetime will be exceeded shortly.

0xa8b0.name: ABB Signal supervision 1
0xa8b0.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 1.

0xa8b1.name: ABB Signal supervision 2
0xa8b1.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 2.

0xa8b2.name: ABB Signal supervision 3
0xa8b2.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 3.

0xa8b3.name: ABB Signal supervision 4
0xa8b3.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 4.

0xa8b4.name: ABB Signal supervision 5
0xa8b4.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 5.

0xa8b5.name: ABB Signal supervision 6
0xa8b5.description: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 6.

0xa8be.name: ULC overload warning
0xa8be.description: Selected signal has exceeded the user overload curve.

0xa8bf.name: ULC underload warning
0xa8bf.description: Selected signal has fallen below the user underload curve.

0xaf80.name: INU-LSU comm loss
0xaf80.description: DDCS (fiber optic) communication between converters (for example, the inverter unit and the supply unit) is lost. Note that the inverter unit will continue operating based on the status...

0xaf85.name: Line side unit warning
0xaf85.description: The supply unit (or other converter) has generated a warning.

0xaf88.name: Season configuration warning
0xaf88.description: You have configured a season which starts before the previous season.

0xaf90.name: Speed controller autotuning
0xaf90.description: The speed controller autotune routine did not complete successfully.

0xafaa.name: Autoreset
0xafaa.description: A fault is about to be autoreset.

0xafe1.name: Emergency stop (off2)
0xafe1.description: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection off2) command.

0xafe2.name: Emergency stop (off1 or off3)
0xafe2.description: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection off1 or off3) command.

0xafe9.name: Start delay
0xafe9.description: The start delay is active and the drive will start the motor after a predefined delay.

0xafed.name: Run permissive
0xafed.description: Run permissive is keeping the drive from running the motor.

0xafee.name: Start interlock 1
0xafee.description: Start interlock 1 is keeping the drive from starting.

0xafef.name: Start interlock 2
0xafef.description: Start interlock 2 is keeping the drive from starting.

0xaff0.name: Start interlock 3
0xaff0.description: Start interlock 3 is keeping the drive from starting.

0xaff1.name: Start interlock 4
0xaff1.description: Start interlock 4 is keeping the drive from starting.

0xaff2.name: Run permissive forced warning
0xaff2.description: A forced DI is used as a source for parameter 20.40 Run permissive.

0xaff3.name: Start interlock forced warning
0xaff3.description: One or more forced DIs is used as a source for one or more of parameters 20.41 Start interlock 1 … 20.44 Start interlock 4.

0xaff5.name: Override new start required
0xaff5.description: The Safe torque off function was active and has been reset while in Override.

0xaff6.name: Identification run
0xaff6.description: Motor ID run will occur at next start.

0xb5a0.name: STO event
0xb5a0.description: Safe torque off function is active, ie, safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector STO is lost.

0xb5a2.name: Power applied
0xb5a2.description: The drive was powered up or the control board was rebooted successfully.

0xb681.name: Hand mode selected
0xb681.description: The drive was placed in Hand mode.

0xb682.name: Off mode selected
0xb682.description: The drive was placed in Off mode.

0xb683.name: Auto mode selected
0xb683.description: The drive was placed in Auto mode.

0xb686.name: Checksum mismatch
0xb686.description: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.

0xb687.name: Auto start command
0xb687.description: The drive received a start command while in Auto mode.

0xb688.name: Auto stop command
0xb688.description: The drive received a stop command while in Auto mode.

0xd405.name: Pipe fill-timeout
0xd405.description: Soft pipe fill has reached timeout limit. The PID output is not reached the setpoint after reference ramping is ended and the timeout limit is elapsed.

0xd406.name: Maximum flow protection
0xd406.description: Actual flow is exceeded the defined fault level.

0xd407.name: Minimum flow protection
0xd407.description: Actual flow is below the defined fault level.

0xd408.name: Outlet minimum pressure
0xd408.description: The measured outlet pressure is below the defined fault limit.

0xd409.name: Outlet maximum pressure
0xd409.description: The measured outlet pressure is above the defined fault limit.

0xd40a.name: Inlet minimum pressure
0xd40a.description: The measured inlet pressure is below the defined fault level.

0xd40b.name: Damper timeout
0xd40b.description: Discharge air or outside air damper has timed out.

0xd40d.name: Multipump run permissive timeout
0xd40d.description: The run permissive setting configured with parameter 20.40 Run permissive was not satisfied within the time set in parameter 76.64 Run permissive timeout from when the drive was commanded to start.

0xd420.name: Reverse flow detected
0xd420.description: The check valve or backflow damper is leaking, which causes the pump or fan to rotate while the drive is stopped.

0xd501.name: No more available PFC motors
0xd501.description: No more PFC motors can be started because they can be interlocked or in the Hand mode.

0xd502.name: All motors interlocked
0xd502.description: All the motors in the PFC system are interlocked.

0xd503.name: VSD controlled PFC motor interlocked
0xd503.description: The motor connected to the drive is interlocked (unavailable).

0xd504.name: Damper timeout
0xd504.description: Discharge air or outside air damper has timed out.

0xd50b.name: Pipe fill-timeout
0xd50b.description: Soft pipe fill is reached the timeout limit. The PID output is not reached the setpoint after reference ramping is ended and timeout limit is elapsed.

0xd50c.name: Maximum flow protection
0xd50c.description: Actual flow is exceeded the defined warning level.

0xd50d.name: Minimum flow protection
0xd50d.description: Actual flow is below the defined warning level.

0xd50e.name: Outlet minimum pressure
0xd50e.description: Measured outlet pressure is below the defined warning limit.

0xd50f.name: Outlet maximum pressure
0xd50f.description: Measured outlet pressure is above the defined warning limit.

0xd510.name: Inlet minimum pressure
0xd510.description: Measured inlet pressure is below the defined warning level.

0xd58b.name: Gas pressure outside limits
0xd58b.description: The compressor gas pressure is outside the limits.

0xfa81.name: Safe torque off 1
0xfa81.description: Safe torque off function is active, that is, STO circuit 1 is broken.

0xfa82.name: Safe torque off 2
0xfa82.description: Safe torque off function is active, that is, STO circuit 2 is broken.

0xff61.name: ID run
0xff61.description: Motor ID run was not completed successfully.

0xff81.name: FB A force trip
0xff81.description: A fault trip command has been received through fieldbus adapter A.

0xff8e.name: EFB force trip
0xff8e.description: A fault trip command has been received through the embedded fieldbus interface.
